chunks.title: 局灶性肺病的分析起点
chunks.text: 教材建议先确定主要受累区域：气道、血管、肺实质或胸膜。肺实质局灶病变再按结节或肿块、肺密度异常及线状影等形态分组。
chunks.quote: On cross-sectional imaging, the first step in diagnosis of focal lung disease is determination of the primary area of involvement: airway, vessel, parenchyma, or pleura.

chunks.title: 为什么比较既往影像
chunks.text: 教材指出，若能取得既往影像，对照有助于理解病变随时间的演变，并帮助判断偶然发现肺结节的意义。
chunks.quote: Comparison with prior imaging studies, when available, is helpful to determine disease temporal evolution, and a concerted effort to obtain prior studies is often the most cost-effective way to determine the significance of an incidental nodule.

chunks.title: 按疾病类别组织鉴别思路
chunks.text: 教材提出用疾病类别组织鉴别思路，优先考虑三个类别及每类两到三个较可能的实体，以减少启发式判断和认知偏差造成的遗漏。此处是教材方法介绍，不是对个体患者的诊断。
chunks.quote: To minimize the likelihood of diagnostic errors associated with failed heuristics and cognitive biases, radiologists should mentally structure their differential diagnosis by categories of disease.

chunks.title: 什么是次级肺小叶 SPL
chunks.text: 次级肺小叶是CT上可见的肺最小功能单位。细支气管和肺动脉分支进入小叶中心；小叶间隔处于周边。
chunks.quote: The SPL is the smallest functional unit of the lung visible on CT. Each bronchiole enters the center of the SPL alongside a pulmonary arterial branch.

chunks.section: 13.2.2 Whole Lung Level: A Simple Algorithm
chunks.title: 微结节分布有哪些类别
chunks.text: 教材介绍的全肺定位方法区分血行性（随机）、沿淋巴性（间质）、小叶中心性，以及与小气道病变相关的结节（小叶中心性的一种）。判断需结合胸膜和叶间裂表面及全肺分布。
chunks.quote: The algorithm presumes four discrete types of micronodules that could be distinguished from one another: hematogenous (random), perilymphatic (interstitial), centrilobular, and small airway disease-associated (SAD) nodules.

chunks.title: 树芽征与感染的关系
chunks.text: 分支状小叶中心结节不一定代表感染或误吸；反过来，感染或误吸也不一定出现典型树芽形态。教材提醒结合其他影像特点与临床信息，不用单一征象直接下结论。
chunks.quote: In addition, not every branching centrilobular nodule is due to infection (bronchiolitis) or aspiration.

chunks.title: MIP在微结节观察中的作用
chunks.text: 教材将MIP层面视为检出和评估微结节的重要补充。此选段只支持其用途说明；具体扫描参数和患者方案请查阅完整原文并由专业人员决定。
chunks.quote: MIP slabs are a key addition to accurately detect and evaluate micronodules.
